decision.observation: 12:40 pm; the C press at the dip reeled the line up again (bobber airborne near the rod top, ~0.61,0.10). It was a nibble, not a hooked fish.
decision.hypothesis: Only the genuine 'HIT!' text marks a real bite; nibble dips just reel in. Recasting and pressing C at the 'HIT!' moment will open the minigame, which I've won once.
decision.memory: Fishing: face water, hold C to cast, press C at 'HIT!' cue; if minigame opens, use LMB holds/releases to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches ship via the porch bin (80G on day 7).
